function: Digital over-the-air aggregation of FEEL model updates: shared VQ and modulation codebooks with AMP-DA detection at the BS; the learned model is a ResNet trained with FedAvg (pp. 3-7).
system: K=40 single-antenna devices (30% active) and an M-antenna BS (M=1, 4, 8), TDD uplink with pre-equalization, SNR 20 dB, no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 9-10).
method: Federated averaging (supervised ResNet) with digital AirComp; K-means++ vector-quantization codebook; AMP-DA is an iterative Bayesian detector with EM, not trained (pp. 5-10).
data_channel: CIFAR-10 non-i.i.d. split over K=40 devices (ResNet, 269,722 parameters); uplink channels i.i.d. complex Gaussian, random Bernoulli modulation codebook; custom simulation (pp. 5, 9-10).
test_conditions: FEEL trained and tested on CIFAR-10 at SNR 20 dB; further runs at SNR 0 and 5 dB, K=100 devices, and with phase or timing offsets (pp. 10-13).
baselines: Earlier digital AirComp designs OBDA [31] and FSK-MV [32] on accuracy; conventional VQ+OFDMA on time slots only; IFed and perfect-aggregation (PA) as upper bounds (p. 10).
metrics: Test accuracy on CIFAR-10, number of transmitted symbols and time slots (Table I), detection NMSE of the aggregation, Ka estimation error PMF (pp. 10-13).
complexity: AMP-DA complexity per round O(I0*L*N*M*D) = O(I0*L*M*2^J*W/Q), linear in quantization level N; no runtime or FLOPs reported (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 5: "assumed to follow a complex Gaussian distribution with zero" mean and unit variance; a custom i.i.d. uplink model, with no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured channel; CIFAR-10 is only the learning-task data.
q2_support: p. 12: "MD-AirComp in a larger cell with K = 100 devices. This only" changes the local dataset; the K, SNR (Table II) and imperfection cases are further FEEL training runs, not a trained model tested on an unseen condition.
q3_support: p. 11: "the final test accuracy of OBDA and FSK-MV compared" with MD-AirComp (earlier digital AirComp designs [31], [32]); p. 10: "of time slots (i.e., transmission delay), of different schemes" (conventional VQ+OFDMA, Table I).
q4_support: p. 8: "training round is of the order of O(I0 LN M D), which equals" O(I0 L M 2J W/Q), the cost of the AMP-DA aggregation.
q5_support: p. 1: "Data is available on-line at https://github.com/liqiao19/MD-AirComp and" https://gaozhen16.github.io/ to facilitate reproducibility.
notes: Included as area 7: the work is a digital over-the-air aggregation scheme for federated edge learning; the aggregator (VQ, codebook modulation, AMP-DA) is a classical iterative design and the learned element is the FEEL model (ResNet, CIFAR-10), which passes no_learning under the federated rule; the BS has M>1 antennas in the main runs (M=4, 8, Fig. 4, p. 11), so the system check does not apply. q3 is borderline: OBDA and FSK-MV are earlier aggregation designs compared on test accuracy, and the non-learned baseline is VQ+OFDMA compared on time slots only (Table I), so the reviewer should confirm.
